$comment: Closed motion vocabulary referenced by the schema enum and section contracts.

smooth-scroll-wheel.description: Lenis wheel smoothing: duration 1.2, ease min(1,1.001-2^-10t), native touch. QA: matched (60fps re-measure).

anchor-scroll.description: In-page anchor scroll with distance-based duration max(0,472.143*ln(d+125)-2000)ms and easeInOutCubic (Webflow-runtime behaviour). QA: matched within ~35ms (60fps re-measure).

text-reveal-word.description: Lines masked, words rise from y 150% -> 0, 1.2s expo.out, delay .1s, stagger .05s; 50% visible trigger; instant reset on full exit; replays.

text-reveal-char-drop.description: As text-reveal-word but per character from y -150% (drop from above).

scramble-text.description: alpha-fade plus scrambleText 0.6-0.9s with quadrant-block chars, revealDelay .3s; flattens inner markup.

scale-line.description: Rule-line scaleX 0 -> 1, 1.2-1.4s expo.out, delay .1s, origin right center unless overridden (name underline: left center).

cta-hover.description: Pill CTA hover: fill text colour, text to page colour (color .2s, background .4s); also triggers webgl-cta-hover-darken on non-mobile UA.

link-hover-opacity.description: Footer nav links fade to opacity .5 over .2s on hover.

webgl-drop-in.description: Object drops from +3 units with back.out over 1.2s after assets load.

webgl-idle-tumble.description: Continuous tumble plus a layer twist every 1680ms (0.8s each).

webgl-scroll-coupling.description: Scroll progress lifts (0.45 units), grows (+0.05, not on mobile UA) and spins the object.

webgl-pointer-inertia.description: Pointer movement adds decaying spin velocity (x0.97 per frame) and x offset (not on mobile UA).

webgl-click-bump.description: Click anywhere: push back and spring (1.6s custom bump ease).

webgl-solve.description: '!' key or form success: full sticker colours (1.8s elastic.out) and page-colour flash to #b71234|#0046ad then restore.

webgl-cta-hover-darken.description: While a CTA is hovered (non-mobile UA): sticker half darkens to 10%, colour map +10%, scale +0.02 (expo.out 1.2s).

final-state-instant.description: Render the final revealed state immediately: no transforms, no scramble, opacity 1. Hover colour swaps may remain (no motion).

static-single-frame.description: Render one static frame of the object at rest; no drop-in, tumble, twist, scroll/pointer coupling or flashes.

no-fade-native-scroll.description: Page visible immediately; native (unsmoothed) scrolling and instant anchor jumps.
